## Summary

`/deliver 1 --yes` — single Story, `dispatchMode: inline`, run inline through the one delivery engine.

- **Implemented** a dependency-free Node core `http` JSON API backed by `node:sqlite` (file-backed, not in-memory):
  - `src/auth.js` — salted scrypt password hashing + constant-time verify; 256-bit opaque bearer sessions.
  - `src/store.js` — SQLite `users`/`sessions`/`notes` tables; unique-username enforcement; per-user note scoping.
  - `src/server.js` — routing for `POST /signup`, `POST /login`, `GET /me`, `POST /notes`, `GET /notes`; JSON body parsing with 400 on malformed/empty/oversized input, 401 on missing/invalid bearer, 404/405 for unknown route/method, top-level catch so no bad request crashes the process; binds `PORT` (default 3000).
  - `package.json` `start` script; `.gitignore` for the DB files.
  - `test/api.test.js` — 8 tests, one per acceptance criterion incl. tenant isolation and a full stop/restart persistence check.
- **Gates:** `node --test` 8/8 pass, typecheck clean, biome format auto-applied, code review 0 findings. Manual `npm start` smoke test served every endpoint on a `PORT`-bound instance.
- **Acceptance self-eval:** `proceed`, 8/8 criteria `met`.
- **Landed:** PR [#2](https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-25-story-scope-mandrel-a8365c59/pull/2) merged to `main` (squash, required checks green); Story #1 → `agent::done`.
